caption:
No fear, no grief: who does Allah promise this to?

Allah says that those who declare their Lord is Allah and then remain steadfast will have no fear, nor will they grieve. Staying firm is a choice we renew every day.

Surah Al-Ahqaf 46:13

Send this to someone who is trying hard to stay firm.

#steadfast #istiqamah #surahahqaf #nofear

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
